summary: Add an immutable, tenant-scoped seller-finance calculation layer over existing order, settlement, cost and operational evidence without introducing a second financial ledger.

impacts.evidence: Financial runs, snapshots, quality issues and source queries use authenticated organization/workspace scope and forced PostgreSQL RLS; report filters cannot select another tenant.
Snapshots keep bounded references, amounts and quality reasons only; raw provider payloads, tokens, bank details and unnecessary PII are excluded and the migration rejects secret-shaped evidence.
Seller P&L, cash-flow, unit-economics, quality, detail and calculation-run paths are additive OpenAPI operations with regenerated Go, Python and TypeScript SDKs.

The calculation layer consumes existing canonical order and settlement facts, records append-only run status evidence, and does not introduce provider-specific event names or bypass the EventBus boundary.
No connector capability or plugin contract is changed; live bank, advertising, marketplace-order, refund and FX adapters remain a separately qualified boundary.
Expand-only migration 46 adds tenant-scoped calculation metadata, immutable snapshots, quality issues and run events, with catalog checksum and backup requirement; source ledgers are not rewritten.
Default-deny finance permissions, bounded request bodies/periods/limits, redacted calculation documents and no-secret constraints protect the report and export boundary.

Financial reports are read-only; manual calculation is separately permissioned and cannot mutate order, payment, settlement or inventory facts. Existing approval controls remain authoritative for financial writes.
Every snapshot retains algorithm, metric, allocation, valuation and attribution versions, input digest, quality coverage and bounded source references; recalculation creates new immutable evidence.

Facts are deduplicated by source/account/reference, calculation runs are tenant-scoped and idempotent, payout is separated from settlement components, and missing/unmatched/disputed states remain visible.
This change makes no external network call or webhook delivery; provider ingestion remains behind existing connector and source-evidence boundaries.
Periods, page sizes, JSON documents and source queries are bounded; the worker logs only scope/status/error codes and defers failed calculations without blocking transactions.
Migration 46 is high-risk expand-only and requires backup; rollback is finance capability disablement and worker drain, with no destructive down migration or snapshot mutation.
Core formula/FIFO tests, API/OpenAPI parity, generated SDK, migration catalog, worker, frontend shell and Docker qualification checks cover the admitted implementation boundary.
